summary: Wooden 80-foot West Bay lookout in Bay County, FL: described in 1948, sold at auction and removed in 2008; parts built a New York tower in 2017. Florida site now undocumented.

facts.design: Wooden tower, 80 feet high (1948 Panama City newspaper)
facts.status_note: Sold at auction for $100 and removed in fall 2008; parts were used to build a tower at Grafton Lakes State Park, New York, in 2017.

events.note: Sold at auction for $100.00 and removed, per the Forest Lookouts page; the page does not name the buyer
Parts used to build a tower at Grafton Lakes State Park, NY; erected December 1, 2017 by Davana LLC at the park's Welcome Center

evidence.supports: 80 feet high, made of wood, two miles north of West Bay (January 1, 1948 Panama City newspaper item)
evidence.quote: January 1, 1948: The West Bay tower, located two miles north of West Bay, is 80 feet high and made of wood.

evidence.supports: sold at auction for $100 and removed in fall 2008
evidence.quote: Fall 2008: The tower was sold at auction for $100.00 and removed.

evidence.supports: three look-out towers finished by fall 1928 at the West Bay Unit, Tyler Unit and Satsuma Heights; the history does not link them to this tower
evidence.quote: By the fall of 1928 State Forester Harry Baker announced the completion of three look-out towers, they were at the West Bay Unit, Tyler Unit and Satsuma Heights

evidence.supports: New York tower erected December 1, 2017 by Davana LLC at the park's Welcome Center
evidence.quote: Erected on December 1, 2017 by Davana LLC at the Grafton Lakes State Park's new Welcome Center.

evidence.supports: restorer's account that the tower was originally in the Florida panhandle at West Bay
evidence.quote: Dave Vana tells me the fire tower was originally located in the Florida panhandle at West Bay

evidence.supports: New York tower built in 2017 from parts of the West Bay tower
evidence.quote: This tower was built in 2017 by Davana LLC utilizing parts of the West Bay Fire Tower from Florida.

evidence.supports: New York tower stands in a children's playground at Grafton Lakes State Park
evidence.quote: located in the children's playground at the Grafton Lakes State Park
has had some special accommodations to make it suitable for small children

corrections.current: relocated to Grafton Lakes Visitor Center, no year; no removal event
corrections.proposed: add removed 2008 (sold at auction and removed); give the relocation year as 2017
corrections.why: Forest Lookouts records the 2008 sale and removal, and the New York newsletter dates the erection to December 1, 2017.

resolved_conflicts.field: origin of the New York tower
resolved_conflicts.explanation: The newsletter reports the restorer's account that the tower was originally at West Bay in the Florida panhandle, and the register repeats that it used West Bay parts. Both are reported; neither gives a build date for the Florida tower.

notes_for_editor: No build date and no staffing history for the Florida tower in any source read. The 1928 Florida Forest Service mention of a West Bay Unit lookout is not tied to this structure by any source; it is named as unconfirmed in the story. The Florida site today is not described anywhere. The 2008 sale rests on the Forest Lookouts page alone. The record's status 'relocated' is accurate.
